_note: Copy to machine.json (untracked) and adjust. Keys you leave out use the platform default from tools/machine.py.

_optional.asr: faster-whisper (default) or mlx on Apple silicon
_optional.asr_device: auto (default), cpu (skip the CUDA attempt, for GPUs without float16/cublas) or cuda (fail instead of falling back)
_optional.render_concurrency: overlay renders side by side (default min(4, cpu/2))
